Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
That old man is out sweeping the street again today.
Do you know him？
No. I just see him cleaning a lot when I pass by.
Huh, I wonder if he does it every day.
He seems nice, so maybe I'll try talking to him. ...Some other time, though. We're on a date right now♪
Anegasaki
Ah... I might run out of throat drops today.
That's rare. You usually carry a bunch with you.
Yeah, I ran out of my stash and just haven't had time to go buy more.
Should we stop by a convenience store, then？
Hmm, I think I'll just hold off for now. Saving money and dieting! Can't ignore the calories in candy, you know.
(She really doesn't need to worry about that...)
Anegasaki
Those kids walking in a line over there must be from the nearby preschool. So cute.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, you always make such a gentle face when you look at little kids.
I do？ I guess I don't really notice it myself...
I bet you're gonna make a really great mom.
Thanks... But before I become a mom, I'd like to be a bride first, y'know？
Ah, watch out. There's a puddle there, so step a bit closer to me.
Anegasaki
Oh, you're right, thanks. I feel like I'm being escorted or something.
That's an exaggeration... Like, "Here, take my hand？" Something like that？
Yeah, yeah, exactly like that.
Anegasaki
That old Western-style house over there. It's been abandoned forever without finding a buyer.
How long is forever？
Probably since way before I was even born.
It's just been sitting there all that time？ Feels like something might live there... like a ghost.
Ooh, that sounds fun... But there'd probably be bugs and mice too. Maybe we shouldn't.
(She's fine with ghosts...)
Anegasaki
When going somewhere familiar, we always end up taking the same route, huh.
Yeah, I guess. No real reason to go out of our way to take another.
I'm just in the mood to walk side-by-side with you a lot today~ Is that bad？
Haha, I think that's fine.
Then let's try taking a slightly different route？
Anegasaki
Wow... That girl we just passed had such thick eyeliner and big lashes.
That's some heavy gyaru makeup. We don't have girls like that at our school.
Yeah, I don't have any friends who do that either...
(I wonder what it'd be like if ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ wore gyaru makeup...)
Hehe. Wanna see me try it？
(Was it showing on my face...)
Anegasaki
That's a toy poodle poking its head out of that woman's bag, right？
It's so tiny. Must still be a puppy.
I heard they don't really change in size much even when they grow up, y'know？
Huh, it'd be funny if it got big, though. Just crammed into that bag.
Aw, poor thing.
That couple we just passed was being awfully flirty in public, huh.
Anegasaki
Hm? Is that your way of saying you want to, too?
That's not it at all... It's just, y'know, hard not to notice.
Hehe, you're all flustered. ...So cute, ▼.
Anegasaki
When you look at store windows, do you ever feel like the mannequins inside just moved?
...Have I？
Is it just me? Like they're about to reach out and grab you...
Wait, wait！
Aw, scaredy-cat~
Anegasaki
Ah, a piano...
Someone must be practicing in their house.
I think it'd be fun to know how to play at least one instrument, too.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ playing an instrument... It feels like you'd play piano at a daycare.
Me as a teacher? That sounds fun, too.
Anegasaki
Hey. What's your ideal type of woman?
There's no one else for me but you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!
Jeez, what a textbook answer.
It's a one-choice question.
You're trying so hard. So cute, ▼.
Anegasaki
What would you do if a zombie suddenly appeared in front of us right now?
Huh? Hmm... First, I'd have to protect you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Hehe, then another zombie appears from behind!
What? Hmm, maybe it's best if we just run away...
Come on, hurry or we'll get surrounded!
(What exactly is she testing me on...?)
Anegasaki
Look, across the street. Think they're a high school couple, too?
Looks like it. Haha, they're so close to each other...
Wanna try getting a little closer ourselves?
Eh！？
You don't have to be so surprised, you know? Come on, let's get close.
Anegasaki
Ah... Eggs were on sale at the supermarket today.
Did you just remember that from seeing the grocery bag that person was holding?
...You're thinking that's not very high schooler-like of me, aren't you?
...Maybe just a little.
Jeez! I was planning to bake some sweets, too. Maybe I won't make any for you?
Anegasaki
The other day, I made friends with a boy who lives down this way.
A boy!?
Yeah, he's five. He's pretty mature and so cute. He said he likes me!
Oh... So it's just a little kid.
Aw, are you jealous? Actually, maybe he was 15, not 5? Are you even more jealous now?
(Give me a break!)
Anegasaki
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. Is something wrong!?
A-A frog...
Oh, it's small, you're fine. Look, it already hopped away.
...Y-Yeah. I don't think I've ever felt more reassured to have you here with me!
Haha, you're exaggerating...
Anegasaki
Hey... I wonder how many times we've walked side by side like this.
I wonder. I haven't exactly been keeping count...
What about holding hands？ Going on dates？ How many times have we eaten together？
Haha, I can't remember all that.
I should have kept track of everything~.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲. You seem to be in a really good mood today.
Anegasaki
No girlfriend is in a bad mood on a date with her boyfriend. Plus...
Plus？
My morning horoscope said my bond with someone special would deepen. And my lucky item is rice bran paste!
(What an old-school horoscope...)
Anegasaki
Ah, watch your step...
Whoa!?
Jeez, be careful, okay？ Do you want your big sis to hold your hand for you？
Aha, you're blushing! Sorry, sorry.
Anegasaki
It seems like a lot of people are jogging lately.
It's easy to get into.
...Maybe I should start. ...It'd be good for a diet, too...
That sounds like a good idea. Not that you need to lose any weight, though.
Sigh... Girls have it tough in ways you can't see, you know.
(I'd better not ask any more about that...)
Anegasaki
What do you think of a guy who only ever takes his girl to places featured in magazines？
Well... I think it can't be helped to some extent.
Right？ My friend was complaining about it, but... The important thing is how you enjoy your time there.
(Thank goodness... It wasn't about ●.)
Anegasaki
Ah... I forgot to withdraw some money. Can we stop by a convenience store？
Sure. But there's no rush. I've got enough on me for now.
Don't try to show off. We're both high schoolers, you know.
Look, a convenience store. I'll be right back.
Anegasaki
There are twins in my class, and they look exactly alike.
Identical twins can be pretty hard to tell apart.
Actually... I'm the younger twin sister, Nana Anegasaki. See, my mole is on the opposite side as Nene's!
What!? ...Wait, it's on the same side.
Just kidding？ It'd be pretty funny if it were true, wouldn't it？
Anegasaki
I kind of want to pick up a new hobby... What do you think would be good？
A new hobby, that's tough... Why the sudden interest, ●？
I was thinking it'd be nice to find something we can do together. We don't really have shared hobbies, huh？
True... But I don't think we need to force it. If we're together long enough, we might pick one up naturally.
Together long enough, huh？ Hehe, you're right. Well said!
Anegasaki
I wonder if I just have bad luck with raffles...
Did you buy a lottery ticket or something？
No. I did the shopping district raffle and got nothing but tissues. All 20 times.
20 times...
Maybe I used up all my luck when I met you. You'd better take responsibility, okay？
Anegasaki
Oh, they put a traffic light at that crosswalk over there.
Now that you mention it, it wasn't there before. A push-button one, huh.
I saw an elderly person struggling to cross before. There's surprisingly heavy traffic here, isn't there？
True. ...Alright, let's test it out!
Heeey, don't play with it.
Anegasaki
Do you believe in fortunes？
I wonder... I think it's best to only believe the good ones.
That really is the best way. Yeah, let's do that.
What do you mean？
I just read a magazine fortune and... Yeah, I shouldn't worry about it!
Anegasaki
Did you know the starry sky was amazing last night？
Oh, was it？
I happened to open my window and the sky was full of stars... I wanted to tell you, but it was already late.
Wow, I definitely would've liked to see that.
Yeah, I wanted to see it with you...
Anegasaki
...Hah.
What's wrong？ Are you... not having fun？
Ah, it's not that... Um, it's just a little hard to say...
I won't force you to say, but... If you're troubled, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I'm here to listen.
I gained a kilo... ...Ugh, jeez! This is a serious issue for a girl, you know.
Anegasaki
A friend of mine makes her boyfriend say 'I love you' to her every single day.
Wow...
Hey. How do you feel about me...？
Ah... 'I love you.'
Yeah, 'I love you' too, ▼.
Anegasaki
Have you ever wondered what it'd be like to use magic？
Let's see... Teleportation would be handy. We could go on dates anywhere!
Aha, that sounds nice too. But I think I'd have to choose a love spell.
You're already using one on me, ●.
It's still not enough. I want you to be completely head over heels for me.
Say, if we go on a date next time, where would you want to go？
Anegasaki
Hmm, going overseas would be nice.
Uh, I'm not sure that counts as a date...
It's a trip, isn't it. Even if we can't go right away, don't you think it'd be nice to go？
(I'll do my best...)
Boy
Excuse me! Could you get our ball for us!?
This one? All right.
Anegasaki
That's pretty far, you know? Are you sure?
Just watch me!
Thanks a lot!
Wow, you really are a guy, aren't you?
（I might've just shown off a little for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.）
Anegasaki
Hey, what kind of ringtone do you use for your texts?
!! That's...
...Hmm？
Haha, what was it again...
Ah, there's a puddle there.
Anegasaki
Oh, thank you. I didn't even notice...
You dressed up so nicely, it'd be a shame if you got splashed with mud.
Hehe, an attentive boyfriend is so wonderful.
Anegasaki
My friend told me she always holds hands when she walks with her boyfriend.
Everywhere they go?
Yeah. ...I'm a little jealous, I guess.
...Should we hold hands too, ●?
At times like this, I want you to take the lead and say "Let's hold hands" without being shy. Come on, okay?
Ah, was I walking a little too fast?
Anegasaki
No, this pace is fine. I can keep up.
Sorry, I was trying to be careful about it...
Yeah, I can tell. You always match my pace, don't you?
Of course. I'm not walking alone, after all.
Uh-huh, you're scoring some major points here.
Huh? The clouds are looking a little suspicious.
Anegasaki
What did the weather forecast say again?
We're finally on a date, so I hope it doesn't rain.
But taking shelter in a cafe ...or sharing an umbrella... I actually really like rainy day dates too.
Male Teacher
Oh, Anegasaki. Don't stay out too late.
Anegasaki
Ah, sir. Yes, I'll be home before it gets dark.
...That startled me. Was that the head teacher for the third years?
Hehe, he looks scary, but he's actually a pretty nice teacher.
Anegasaki
It's dangerous for kids to cross that road by themselves. ...Wait here a second.
Okay, everyone. Make sure you raise your hands when you cross.
You know, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I think you'd make a great preschool teacher.
You think so? I do like kids, but...
Did you see that horror special yesterday? The one where they slip into a spatial distortion and meet yokai...
Anegasaki
I did! I wasn't expecting much from it, but it was actually really good!
I knew you'd watch it.
Yeah, I figured I should check it out. You could really feel the homage to the classics!
O-Oh, yeah... So, on the show that aired right after...
Hey, listen to me. So anyway...
(Crap. Why did I even bring this up...?)
Anegasaki
You know how they show B-movie horror films late at night sometimes？
Yeah. Are those kinds of movies in your wheelhouse too, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Uh-huh. They broadcast stuff that isn't on DVD, so you can find some real hidden gems.
Wow. They're on pretty late, though. Don't you get sleepy？
I can handle the sleepiness, but... it's bad for my skin, you know？ I get bags under my eyes.
Anegasaki
My friend is going on a trip and said she'd buy me a souvenir. She really doesn't need to go out of her way.
Huh. A lot of tourist trap souvenirs can be pretty hit-or-miss, though...
That's where she gets to show off her skills, right？ With her taste, I think I can expect something good.
I'm jealous of that.
Right？ When I see a store full of souvenirs, I always end up thinking, 'What do I do~?'
You've been looking at me and smiling for a while now, ●... Is there something on my face？
Anegasaki
Ah, sorry. I didn't mean anything weird by it... Promise you won't laugh？
I won't laugh.
I was just thinking you have really nice ears.
Wait, my ears？
...That is pretty weird, isn't it. Yeah, let's drop it. Sorry.
Anegasaki
I had a scary dream last night. I was sleeping in bed, and right in front of me was a vampire...
Haha, maybe you've been watching too many movies？
But when I looked closely, it was you. So I thought... maybe I wouldn't mind having my blood sucked~
● drank ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s blood？
Yeah. I ended up waking up halfway through, though. It got my heart racing a bit...
Anegasaki
Did you know Towano City's urban legends have been a hot topic lately？
Wow, I didn't know we had those.
They were even featured in a magazine. Like the old woman who... runs at super speed... or something...
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
N-Never mind. I'm sure my eyes were playing tricks on me. There's no way an old lady could outrun a bike...
(No way... Did she see her!?)
Anegasaki
There was a boy in my class who said his dream is to have his girlfriend clean his ears. Do you feel the same way？
I guess... I wouldn't mind you doing that for me.
Hmm... You want me to blow softly in your ear, too？ Let's see here...
Whoa... Not right now!
Hehe, you're so cute, ▼.
Anegasaki
Do you ever wish you could go back in time？
Hmm... It'd be nice to go back to when I wouldn't get yelled at for not studying.
Hehe, I see. I don't really want to go back, myself.
Why？
Because the time before I met you was so boring, right？
Anegasaki
I've been thinking lately that being a boyfriend is hard work.
Why's that？ Do you think it's that hard, ●？
It just seems like my friend's boyfriend is always getting bossed around by her.
Ah, there are couples like that. But maybe they're happy that way？
Hehe, every couple has their own kind of happy？ Maybe so.
Anegasaki
That thicket over there... I used to play explorer in it when I was little.
Oh really. You did, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I thought it was a huge forest back then, but looking at it now, it's not that big.
I know that feeling. You realize you've grown up, and it makes you feel a little sad.
I wonder if I'll feel differently about it in another ten years or so.
Anegasaki
Compared to the past, the scenery in this town has changed quite a bit.
Is that so. I don't know what this town used to look like.
People who've lived here forever say there used to be a lot more nature, and it was really rural.
Wow, now it totally feels like a booming new city.
I'm sure it'll keep on changing... Someday, you'll probably feel nostalgic for this view too, you know？
Anegasaki
Eh？
What's wrong？
I thought the person who just walked by was the manager.
Did they look that much like him？
No, I guess not really. He just has a common face.
Well, that's true.
Anegasaki
Looks like a new family restaurant is opening up near Dexee's.
Is that so. Well, as long as they have you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, Dexee's won't lose!
I can't do it alone. We all have to do our best. And that includes you, of course？
All right~
Anegasaki
Ah! Hey, they say if you add up all the numbers on that delivery truck's license plate and it's even, your wish comes true.
Girls really love that kind of stuff, huh.
Aw, you're making fun of me. Fine, I wished for something about us, but I guess it won't come true.
Jeez, don't make such a pitiful face. You're so cute.
Anegasaki
Oh, there's an RV parked over there. I'd love to take a trip in a vehicle like that.
Oh, are you surprisingly outdoorsy, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Not really, but doesn't it kind of excite you？ It's like a little secret base.
A secret base, huh... Thinking about it like that is pretty exciting.
Right？ See？
Anegasaki
Ah, that cat!!
Huh, what about the cat？
It looked exactly like a cat that ran away from my neighborhood... I wish I could've caught it.
It can't be helped. Cats are fast runners.
...Yeah. I should at least let the owner know.
Anegasaki
Aw, that baby is so cute!
You're right. Maybe about a year old？
How nice... I really do want a baby.
Eh！？
Hm？ Don't like babies？
(That's not it, but...)
Anegasaki
Ah, watch your step.
...Whoa!?
...There's a dip in the road. That's dangerous. Are you okay？
...Haha, I'm fine. Just tripped a little.
Be careful not to get hurt. I'd hate it if we couldn't hang out together.
Anegasaki
...Ah, look out!
Eh！？
What the!? Water fell from above...
Someone in the apartment above probably dumped it... That was close.
If ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ hadn't warned me, I might've gotten soaked...
I wonder what's going on. There's a crowd forming.
Anegasaki
'Shopping District Surprise'？ Must be a TV shoot.
Wanna try getting on TV？
No thanks, I mean... It'd be embarrassing if they filmed us together, right？
Aw, isn't it a bit late for that？
I guess, but that's totally different.
It's just a little awkward if someone we know sees us out on a date like this.
Anegasaki
You're so bashful. It's cute, ▼.
Well, you know, they might tease us about it the next day.
We aren't doing anything wrong, so I think we should just hold our heads high.
(I definitely can't be as confident as ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Were you looking at that dress in the shop window earlier？
Anegasaki
...You noticed. It was pretty, but I'd never have a chance to wear it.
Yeah, it didn't really seem like a dress for high schoolers. It'd look great on ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Are you saying I look old？
Eh!? U-Um, that's not what I meant!
You get so cute when you panic. It makes me want to tease you sometimes...
(...Sometimes？)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. ...Did you call me？
● didn't say anything, though.
...That's weird. I definitely heard someone call my name.
Don't say scary things like that.
Hmm, maybe it was my imagination.
(...Just her imagination, right？)
Anegasaki
There's another moving truck parked over there. Lots of people moving in lately.
Towano City is still growing, huh.
Even if it keeps changing, I really love this city.
● wasn't sure about it when first moving here, but after meeting ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I think I've come to love this city.
Jeez, you're saying such sweet things.
Anegasaki
A friend of mine said she wants her boyfriend to hug her from behind.
A 'friend'...？
Yeah... Ah, it really is a friend! I'm not talking about 'me', okay？
Haha, right. They say when you talk about a friend, you're really talking about yourself.
...Well, of course I'd love to be hugged like that too, but...
Anegasaki
...Did you see that car just now？ The person driving it...
I didn't, but... Haha, were they wearing a mascot costume or something？
...I think it was a werewolf. And Frankenstein was in the passenger seat.
...Seriously？ Is it for some kind of attraction？
Yeah, probably. But I wonder if they'll get pulled over for that.
Anegasaki
...Hey, do I look weird today？
I think you look cute, though？
Jeez...▼ Ah, wait, not that. I meant my skin. Does it look bad today？
...You think so？
Yeah. I wonder what it is. Late nights？ Vitamins？ Wait, stress!?
(I think she looks beautiful though...)
Anegasaki
Ah... the tree that used to be there got cut down.
Come to think of it, there was a pretty old tree there.
Yeah. When something that was always there suddenly disappears, it makes you feel a little lonely.
Nothing lasts forever... I guess that's how it goes.
...We'll be together forever, right？
...Whoops.
Anegasaki
...You're acting pretty boyfriend-like, huh？
Eh？ What？
You're always casually protecting me, you know.
I don't know about casual. ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲When I'm with you, I'm actually trying pretty hard.
So modest. Not letting the other person notice is what gets you high points, you know？
Anegasaki
Ah, a contrail. Doesn't it make you happy when you spot one sometimes？
It really does. When I was a kid, I used to make a huge fuss over them.
Did you just think I was being childish？
That's not exactly it...
It's fine, it's way better than being treated like an old lady.
(So being treated like a kid is fine...)
Anegasaki
...Like that bicycle just now, I feel like there are a lot of reckless drivers lately.
School routes and stuff are pretty dangerous, huh.
You're careful, right？
Of course. ...Is what I want to say, but sometimes I go a little fast.
Hey. Don't forget you have a girlfriend who'd be heartbroken if you got into an accident, okay？
Anegasaki
A friend of mine said she often goes to karaoke alone.
Solo karaoke, huh... Doesn't she go with friends？
She said it's practice for when she goes with everyone. Maybe I should go practice too.
Then, ●I'll go with you too.
Then it wouldn't be solo karaoke. That defeats the whole purpose of practicing.
Anegasaki
Hey, what would you do if cell phones just disappeared from the world？
Hmm... I'd be in trouble!
I mean, yeah, but...
I wouldn't be able to call or text ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, and I'd have no way to look up date spots...
Jeez, is there anything else？
(...Maybe she'd be fine？)
Anegasaki
I heard the cafe by the station has a new menu. Their mille-feuille is supposed to be amazing.
You're always so quick to catch onto things like that, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
It's a mix of business and pleasure... I hope we can add some new sweets to the menu at Dexee's.
(I wonder which one she cares about more...)
Anegasaki
...Hah.
A sigh？ Did something happen？
A new crepe shop opened in my neighborhood recently, and it always smells so sweet whenever I walk by...
A sweet temptation, huh.
I barely held back today. ...I wonder how much longer I can resist.
(She doesn't have to push herself that hard...)
Anegasaki
Look at the little kids playing in the park. Hearing them makes me feel happy, too.
Well, you've always loved kids, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
That's true, but don't you feel like they just give you energy, too？
Yeah, I definitely had way too much energy when I was little.
Don't sound like an old man. Come on, let's show them how energetic we can be.
Looks like that store is closing. They're having a closing down sale.
Anegasaki
Hehe, is that what you thought？
Why？
That store is always having a closing down sale. Nobody complains since you can get things for cheap, though.
(Is that really okay...)
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Have you been eating out a lot lately, too？
For the most part, yeah.
Hmm... Oh, I know! Want me to write down some easy recipes for you？
I wonder if you can actually pull that off, ●.
I'll be fine! I cook at Dexee's all the time, don't I？ See？
(I wonder about that...)
Anegasaki
Ah, walking past a pet shop always makes me want to take one home...
They are pretty cute.
I have to try my best not to make eye contact.
Because it's game over if you do？
Exactly. I'd definitely want to take them home with me.
Anegasaki
Oh, they're running again today.
Do you know that person？
Yeah, they're a neighbor. It's been about a month now. Looks like they're keeping at it.
Jogging, huh... I don't think you'd last very long, ●.
You have your club, after all. As for me, I have a pair of running shoes I've only ever worn three times.
(Guess she gave up on it...)
Deliveryman
Hello!
Anegasaki
Oh, hello. Thanks for your hard work as always.
Was that delivery guy a friend of yours?
Not really a friend, but we greet each other a lot.
You know a lot of people around here, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, not just friends.
Really? I thought it was normal. Why don't you try meeting more people too? Getting to know your neighbors is fun.
Anegasaki
Something just... brushed past my feet.
Oh, it's a cat. Hey, you shouldn't go scaring ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ like that, okay?
It's fine, don't be mad. You didn't mean it, did you~?
Anegasaki
Did something shine in those bushes?
Hmm, I didn't notice anything.
Animal eyes, like a cat's...
So, wasn't it a cat?
It was too big for a cat... A lion?
(No way...)
Anegasaki
Want me to guess what you're thinking about right now?
You sound confident? Let's hear it!
Hehe, "I want to hold her hand"?
Haha, spot on. How'd you know?
Because I was thinking the exact same thing♪
Anegasaki
I actually just started keeping a pet.
Are you allowed to have pets at your place, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲?
No, I can't. So it's a digital pet on my phone. It's actually pretty cute.
Oh, are you hooked?
I might get hooked soon. I love how they gradually get attached to you.
(I'm a little jealous of a pet that gets doted on by ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Anegasaki
You never really get bored staying in a convenience store, do you?
Yeah, you end up staying too long in the magazine section.
For me, it's the snacks. There are so many throat drops, it's fun deciding which one to get.
Wow, you think about it every time.
I have my favorites, but I like to change it up based on my mood. Like lemon because it's sunny, or plum because it's Monday, you know?
(What kind of logic is that?)
Anegasaki
It really is strange, isn't it?
Scared of what？
When we first met, I never could've imagined us walking side-by-side on a date like this.
You were thinking about back then?
Just occasionally. I suddenly remember when we first met. I don't think I'll ever forget it.
Anegasaki
It's fun just flipping through fashion magazines.
Girls just love fashion, you know.
That's not all. When you have a boyfriend, you look at magazines differently.
Yep. Your girlfriend's working hard, you know？
Anegasaki
You at school, you at Dexee's, you right now... They're all different.
Um... Like my clothes？
That's the obvious one, but your expressions and vibe are different too.
I see... But that's the same for ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ from ●'s perspective.
...Ah, I guess so. That's kind of funny.
Anegasaki
Do you believe in 'love charms'？
Hmm, love charms. Girls really love that kind of stuff, huh.
I guess guys don't really believe in them. I've been doing one, though...
What kind？
